description: How to pay an order that waits for payment, as an agent, over HTTP 402: an Audit (audit) or its renewal (renewal), a Payment proof (proof), a Tool comparison (stack3, stack) or a data plan (builder, team). A data plan paid this way runs one month and doesn't renew by itself: order and pay it again before it ends, and the next month follows on. It gives the payment URL, the price and the protocols on now (protocols; MPP: a card through a Stripe Shared Payment Token, or USDC on Tempo or Base; x402: USDC on Base). A POST to the URL without a credential answers 402 with the challenges of the rails that are on (WWW-Authenticate for MPP, PAYMENT-REQUIRED for x402); the same request with a credential from an MPP client or x402 wallet answers with the receipt and queues the drive (a data plan: your key has the plan at once). The price is the listed price, as at the card checkout before VAT: a renewal's price, an Audit's paid plan and its purchase with your code at cost, less a promotion code of ours given with the order. The price includes any VAT and every payment has a receipt; buyer {vat_id, company, address} as the JSON body of both requests, or with the order, puts the business on our invoice. On a person's account the card checkout works too (payment.url from ordering); an agent's own account has none until a person claims it. test_mode: true means Stripe's test mode, where no real money moves.
